name: Brigade Enclave
description: A low-rise project of 215 apartments in G+6 blocks at Moti Nagar, within walking distance of Erragadda Metro. Homes have no common walls, and a 20,000 sq.ft clubhouse serves the community.
curation: Only 215 homes in blocks of seven floors
amenities: Kids' play area and pet park
developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
photoDescription: Aerial view of low-rise residential blocks
